title: Northwind Insurance · claim status page
subtitle: Time and materials · personal data
brief: Northwind Insurance (Germany). Customers phone the contact centre to ask where their home-insurance claim is. We want an online claim status page. Planned: 2 engineers for 4 weeks, starting Dec 7, billed time-and-materials at $600 per engineer-day. Budget is tight this year. The claims system had a six-hour outage last month. Claim calls peak in early January. Customers identify themselves today by claim number.

title: Harbor Freight · support extension
subtitle: Time and materials · $450 per day
brief: Our support team for Harbor Freight's shipment-tracking platform is overloaded. The ticket backlog grew from 40 to 110 in three months, and P2 tickets now take 5 days on average instead of the agreed 2. The client has complained twice in monthly reviews. Idea: add one full-time support engineer for 6 months, working the client's business hours, on P2 and P3 tickets. Billed at $450 per engineer-day. Their finance head questions every new role. Their peak shipping season runs from November to January.

title: Summit Ridge Credit Union · change request
subtitle: Fixed price · $40,000 change budget
brief: We are in month 3 of a fixed-price portal modernisation (contract $180,000). Summit Ridge's loan officers now ask for a loan application status screen in the staff portal, with search by application number and a status timeline, instead of emailing the back office (about 300 status emails a week, replies take up to two days). They have an approved change budget of $40,000 this quarter. Estimate: 6 weeks, 2 engineers, $550 per engineer-day. Their new CTO joined two months ago, personal financial data is audited every year, quarter-end (last week of December) is their busiest time, and they want a pilot in one branch first.
